name: Webform SMSAPI
description: sends SMS from webform submissions via the SMSAPI module.
project_description:
Webform SMSAPI is a module enhancing functionality of both SMSAPI and Webform modules. It provides the webform handler to send SMS messages after submitting the form. 

 The extension requires the base SMSAPI module installation to work properly.

 

 

 Back to top 

 Features 
 

 
 Sending SMS messages with content based on data from the submitted form. 
 Complex integration of custom templates provided by the SMSAPI base module. 
 Sending fully customized SMS messages. 
 
 

 

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 

 
 SMSAPI - base module installation.
